name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 'branch-*'
      - 'dogfood-on-*'
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  ENV_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
  ENV_PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  DEPLOY_PULL_REQUEST: true
  ARTIFACTORY_DEPLOY_REPO: sonarsource-public-qa
  ARTIFACTORY_DEPLOY_USERNAME: vault-${{ github.repository_owner }}-${{ github.event.repository.name }}-qa-deployer

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write  # Required for Vault OIDC authentication
  contents: write  # Required for repository access and tagging

jobs:
  get-build-number:
    name: Preload build number
    runs-on: github-ubuntu-latest-s
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ steps.get_build_number.outputs.BUILD_NUMBER }}
    steps:
      - uses: SonarSource/ci-github-actions/get-build-number@v1
        id: get_build_number
  build:
    needs: get-build-number
    env:
      BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ needs.get-build-number.outputs.BUILD_NUMBER }}
    runs-on: github-ubuntu-latest-s  # Using custom GitHub-hosted runner for public repo
    name: Build and Test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@08c6903cd8c0fde910a37f88322edcfb5dd907a8 # v5.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Fetch all history for git operations

      - uses: jdx/mise-action@146a28175021df8ca24f8ee1828cc2a60f980bd5 # v3.5.1

      - uses: SonarSource/ci-github-actions/config-npm@v1
        id: config
        with:
          artifactory-reader-role: private-reader
      # Fetch vault secrets for build
      - name: Vault
        id: secrets
        uses: SonarSource/vault-action-wrapper@v3 # v3.1.0

            development/kv/data/sign passphrase | GPG_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE;

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
